messages:
Ivy (AE): Heads-up: HealthSync POC finished and they want to convert. Legal sent DPA redlines; procurement needs PO flow + e-invoice format. Can we align on fastest sign route so they can issue PO?

Marco (SE): Security flagged SAML SSO + SOC2. They also asked if BYOK/HSM is available for later private deployment. For POC they accept managed keys.

Hana (Legal): DPA redlines summary: (1) 30-day data export, (2) subprocessor approval, (3) liability cap at 1x fees. We can accept (1) & (2) with stronger security attestations; liability cap needs legal lead sign-off. I'll add comments.

Pri (Procurement): PO checklist: full billing entity name, tax id/VAT, remit address, PO number, two authorized signers, and e-invoice endpoint (if Ariba/Peppol). They prefer DocuSign and customer-first signing. Who collects signers?

Ivy (AE): I'll collect. Tentative signers: Laura Chen (CFO) + Miguel Ortega (Head of Procurement). Billing entity: HealthSync Therapeutics Inc.

Ethan (Finance): Billing terms: Finance prefers Net30; if they require Net45 we need revenue ops approval. Need billing contact email and remittance instructions on order form. Also GL code mapping if PO-match required.

Ivy (AE): Draft order form snippet I'm about to send:

```
Order Form
Customer: HealthSync Therapeutics Inc.
Billing contact: ap@healthsync.com
Remit address: 210 Bio Park, Suite 100, San Diego, CA 92121
Tax ID/VAT: EIN 07-1234567
Term: 12 months
Commit: $64,000 / month
Billing terms: Net30 (Net45 possible with Finance approval)
One-time onboarding credit: $6,000 applied to invoice #1 upon completion of onboarding milestone
Signers: Laura Chen (CFO), Miguel Ortega (Head Procurement)
Notes: BYOK/HSM available for Private deployments per separate SOW; not in scope for POC
```

Marco (SE): Confirm onboarding milestone mapping: we can map the $6k credit to completion of staged validation within first 30 days.

Hana (Legal): Add e-sign clause: "Electronic signatures (DocuSign or equivalent) have the same legal effect as originals." Also will flag liability cap to emma_r for exec approval if customer insists on 1x fees.

Pri (Procurement): For e-invoicing: if they use Ariba/Peppol provide endpoint and sample UBL. If not, PDF via DocuSign + email is fine. They may require PO before countersign in their internal rules; prefer customer sign -> vendor countersign -> PO issued.

Ethan (Finance): If PO arrives after countersign, put "PO to follow" on invoice so AR can bill. Also please cc finance-billing@redwood.com and include AP contact.

ops-privacy-bot: SOC2 report attached: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-healthsync-2026

Ivy (AE): Final send checklist: (1) updated order form with billing + onboarding credit + BYOK note, (2) redlined DPA with Hana's comments, (3) DocuSign flow: customer signs then Redwood countersigns, (4) cc: ops-privacy@redwood.com, finance-billing@redwood.com, Hana. Anything else?

Hana (Legal): Please include priya@redwood.com in cc for procurement questions, and escalate to legal lead emma_r if liability cap deviation required.

Pri (Procurement): I'll request their Ariba endpoint and signer confirmation. If they need automated invoicing, ask for UBL sample now to avoid delays.

Ivy (AE): Thanks all. I'll send OF + DPA redline to HealthSync legal and post replies here. :thumbsup:
